M-COMMON.NAME: Filesystem and index helpers
M-COMMON.purpose: Project-root discovery, safe index reading, deterministic file walking and table formatting.

fn-findProjectRoot.PURPOSE: Walk up to docs/graph-index.xml; throws ProjectNotFoundError.

fn-tryFindProjectRoot.PURPOSE: Non-throwing root discovery, null when absent.

fn-parseXmlAttributes.PURPOSE: v1-compatible attribute helper delegating to grace-xml.

fn-readIndexFile.PURPOSE: Read an index: missing file yields [], malformed throws XmlError.

fn-readIndexFileSafe.PURPOSE: Non-throwing index read returning entries plus an optional XmlError.

fn-readFileOrNull.PURPOSE: File content or null when absent.

fn-readTextFileOrThrow.PURPOSE: Readable UsageError when a required file is unreadable.

fn-listEntityFiles.PURPOSE: Sorted .xml files in a directory filtered by id prefix.

fn-walkFiles.PURPOSE: Deterministic recursive walk with ignore dirs/exts and no symlink following.

fn-formatTable.PURPOSE: Aligned text table that tolerates ragged rows.

fn-countLines.PURPOSE: Line count used by index caps and size budgets.

contract.purpose: Project-root discovery, safe index reading, deterministic file walking and table formatting.

param.name: startDir
param.description: Directory to start the root search from.

notes.note-1: The root walk is bounded: resolve(dir, ..) reaches the filesystem root, so a missing project fails fast.
notes.note-2: walkFiles never follows symlinks, which avoids loops and escaping the project tree.
notes.note-3: readIndexFileSafe is the reporting-friendly variant used by lint, status, doctor and context-cost.
